ux_applicability_justification: This phase is entirely test-infrastructure work: (1) prod-smoke opt-in gating with live-smoke-guard.ts helper, (2) marketing test docblock/env pragma fixes, (3) package.json test-script flag changes (removing --passWithNoTests), (4) wave2 guard/inventory test files, and (5) types regression guard. The 31 changed files are: 26 test files (*.test.ts, *.test.tsx), 1 test helper (live-smoke-guard.ts), 2 test fixtures (live-default.fixture.ts, opt-in-gated.fixture.ts), 1 test data file (report-summary.json), 3 package.json files (test scripts only), and 1 measure plan.md. Zero production/app source files were modified: no route handlers, no page components, no layout components, no domain functions, no API contracts, no tRPC routers, no form or page flow changes. The package.json changes are limited to the 'test' script key — no 'build', 'start', or other production scripts were touched. Removing --passWithNoTests does not affect build/start behavior; it only changes test runner behavior when zero test files match the glob. The prod-smoke opt-in gating converts live-default test files to opt-in-only behind RUN_LIVE_SMOKE=true; this is a test-infra concern, not a UX/API contract change.

app_route_handlers.detail: No route.ts or route.tsx files in the diff

page_components.detail: No page.tsx or layout.tsx files in the diff

api_contracts.detail: No contract/schema/zod files in the diff; no tRPC router modifications

domain_functions.detail: No domain/service/action/query/mutation files in the diff

package_json_changes.detail: apps/codecamp-advantage/package.json: 'vitest run --passWithNoTests' → 'vitest run'; apps/sales-advantage/package.json: same change; packages/reading-advantage-scripts/package.json: 'jest --passWithNoTests' script removed entirely (empty scripts object)

nonblocking_observations: 6 describe block names in marketing tests still contain 'RED' (e.g., '(task 2, RED, phase-6-jsonb-schema)'). These are task identifiers from original test design, not docblock markers. The wave2-test-truthfulness guard correctly targets 'RED at HEAD' docblock patterns. All 50 affected tests pass. Noted in review-a as non-blocking.
packages/reading-advantage-scripts/package.json now has an empty scripts object. This is acceptable — the package had 0 tests; the jest --passWithNoTests was a vacuous-pass surface.
handoff: Phase 3 Review-C complete. No blocking findings. UX/API applicability: NOT APPLICABLE — this is test-infra-only work. The diff touches only *.test.ts/tsx files, test helpers/fixtures/data, package.json test scripts, and the measure plan. No production/app source, route handlers, page components, API contracts, domain functions, or UI flows were modified. Removing --passWithNoTests and gating prod-smoke behind RUN_LIVE_SMOKE=true do not affect runtime or build behavior — they only affect test runner behavior. All 31 changed files are confirmed as test infrastructure. Handing off to orchestrator for phase closeout.
